blocks.text: I want to go va I want you to go

52-darsda **want to** ni ko'rdik: I **want to go** — men o'zim bormoqchiman. Agar **boshqa odam** nimadir qilishini xohlasak, want bilan to orasiga o'sha odam qo'yiladi: I **want you to go** — «borishingni xohlayman». O'zbekchada bu fe'lga egalik qo'shimchasi bilan beriladi: bor**ishingni**, kel**ishingizni**, o'qi**shini** xohlayman. Inglizchada esa qolip qat'iy: **want + kishi + to + fe'l**. «I want that you go» — xato: bu fe'llardan keyin that bilan ergash gap ishlatilmaydi.

Kishi o'rnida **ob'ekt olmoshi** turadi: me, you, him, her, it, us, them (batafsil — 59-dars). «I want **he** to go» emas, **him** to go. Olmosh o'rnida ism yoki ot ham bo'lishi mumkin: I want **my son** to study, She wants **everybody** to come.

items.text: Do you **want me to wait** for you?
My parents **want me to become** a lawyer.

blocks.text: **Do you want me to ...?** / **Would you like me to ...?** — yordam taklif qilishning odatiy usuli: Do you **want me to carry** it? — «Ko'tarib boraymi?»; Would you **like me to call** a taxi? — «Taksi chaqirib beraymi?» O'zbekchada bu «-aymi?» shakliga to'g'ri keladi.

**would like** ham xuddi shu qolipda keladi, faqat muloyimroq: I**'d like you to meet** my wife — «Rafiqam bilan tanishishingizni istardim». Bu shakl rasmiy vaziyatda — ishda, mehmonxonada, shifoxonada ko'p eshitiladi. would like haqida — 34-dars.

Kimgadir nimadir qilishni **aytish**, **so'rash**, **maslahat berish**, **eslatish**, **o'rgatish** fe'llari ham shu qolipda: tell / ask / advise / remind / invite / teach / expect + kishi + to + fe'l. Bu — buyruq gapni o'zlashtirma gapga aylantirishning eng oson yo'li (50-dars): «Sit down, please.» → She **asked me to sit** down. **help** dan keyin to ixtiyoriy: help me **carry** = help me **to carry**.

rows: She **asked me to open** the window.
She **advised me to see** a doctor.
He **told me not to touch** it.

items.text: The teacher **told us to close** our books.
Lola **asked me to help** her with the shopping.
items.translation: Lola mendan xarid qilishda **yordam berishimni so'radi**.

blocks.text: Inkor: told me not to, don't want you to

Inkor ikki xil bo'ladi. (1) Ikkinchi fe'l inkor — **not** to dan oldin turadi: She **told me not to go** — «bormasligimni aytdi». (2) Birinchi fe'l inkor: I **don't want you to go** — «ketishingni xohlamayman». O'zbekchada «Sen bormasligingni xohlayman» ham deyiladi, lekin inglizchada «I want you not to go» kam ishlatiladi — tabiiy shakli: **I don't want you to go**.

**make** va **let** ham shu qolipda (fe'l + kishi + fe'l), lekin **to qo'yilmaydi**: make somebody **do**, let somebody **do**. **make** — majbur qilmoq yoki biror holatga solmoq: She **made me laugh** — «meni kuldirdi». O'zbekchada bunga ko'pincha orttirma nisbat qo'shimchasi (`-tir`, `-dir`, `-t`) mos keladi: kul**dir**di, kut**tir**di, yig'la**t**di. **let** — ruxsat bermoq, qo'ymoq: My parents **let me go** — «ota-onam borishimga ruxsat berishdi». **Let me** + fe'l — yordam taklifi: **Let me help** — «Yordam beray».

items.text: My parents **didn't let me go** to the concert.
**Let me carry** that bag for you.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I want that you come.» → **I want you to come.**; «I want you come.» → **I want you to come.** (to tushib qolmasin); «I want you don't go.» → **I don't want you to go.**; «She told me go.» → **She told me to go.**; «He said me to wait.» → **He told me to wait.** (say dan keyin kishi kelmaydi); «I want he to stay.» → **I want him to stay.**; «My mother made me to clean my room.» → **made me clean**; «Let me to help.» → **Let me help.**

Eslab qolish: **want, would like, ask, tell, advise, remind, invite, teach** + kishi + **to**. Faqat ikkita «qisqa» fe'l — **make** va **let** — to siz: make me **laugh**, let me **go**. Ikkalasi ham to'rt harfli va ikkalasidan keyin ham to yo'q.

rows: advise / remind / invite / teach + kishi + to

examples.title: **I want you to** ...: what we want others to do
examples.description: want + kishi (me, you, him, her, us, them yoki ism) + to + fe'l: boshqa odam nima qilishini xohlaymiz. O'zbekchada: «kelishingizni xohlayman».

sentences.text: I **want you to meet** my parents.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam bilan **tanishishingizni xohlayman**.

sentences.text: My boss **wants me to work** on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'im shanba kuni **ishlashimni xohlaydi**.

sentences.text: Do you **want me to carry** your bag?
sentences.translation: Sumkangizni **ko'tarib boraymi**?

sentences.text: Dilnoza **wants her son to study** medicine.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza o'g'lining tibbiyotda **o'qishini xohlaydi**.

sentences.text: What **do** you **want us to bring** to the party?
sentences.translation: Ziyofatga nima **olib kelaylik**?

sentences.text: The teacher **wanted everybody to speak** only English in class.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi darsda hamma faqat inglizcha **gapirishini xohladi**.

sentences.text: Our neighbours **want the city to build** a new playground.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz shahar yangi bolalar maydonchasi **qurishini xohlashadi**.

sentences.text: Tom, **do** you **want me to call** you a taxi?
sentences.translation: Tom, sizga taksi **chaqirib beraymi**?

sentences.text: Grandma **wants all of us to come** to Samarkand for her birthday.
sentences.translation: Buvim tug'ilgan kuniga hammamiz Samarqandga **kelishimizni xohlaydi**.

sentences.text: Why **does** Bekzod **want you to leave** so early?
sentences.translation: Nega Bekzod sizning bunchalik erta **ketishingizni xohlayapti**?

examples.title: **would like** somebody **to**: polite wishes
examples.description: would like + kishi + to — xohishni muloyimroq aytish. **Would you like me to ...?** — yordam taklif qilish («... qilib beraymi?»).

sentences.text: I**'d like you to read** this letter carefully.
sentences.translation: Bu xatni diqqat bilan **o'qib chiqishingizni istardim**.

sentences.text: **Would** you **like me to help** you with the dishes?
sentences.translation: Idishlarni yuvishga **yordamlashib yuboraymi**?

sentences.text: The director **would like everyone to arrive** by nine.
sentences.translation: Direktor hamma soat to'qqizgacha **kelishini istaydi**.

sentences.text: We**'d like our children to learn** another language.
sentences.translation: Farzandlarimiz yana bir chet tilini **o'rganishini istardik**.

sentences.text: Mrs Smith **would like you to call** her back this afternoon.
sentences.translation: Missis Smit bugun tushdan keyin unga **qayta qo'ng'iroq qilishingizni istaydi**.

sentences.text: Excuse me, **would** you **like me to take** a photo of you both?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, ikkalangizni **suratga olib qo'yaymi**?

sentences.text: My parents **would like me to live** closer to them.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam ularga yaqinroq **yashashimni istashadi**.

sentences.text: Before the exam, Mr Brown **would like us to revise** units one to ten.
sentences.translation: Imtihondan oldin janob Braun birdan o'ngacha bo'limlarni **takrorlashimizni istaydi**.

sentences.text: Madina, I**'d like you to meet** my colleague James.
sentences.translation: Madina, hamkasbim Jeyms bilan **tanishishingizni istardim**.

sentences.text: **Would** you **like** the waiter **to bring** some more tea?
sentences.translation: Ofitsiant yana choy **olib kelishini xohlaysizmi**?

examples.title: **tell** / **ask** somebody **to** ...
examples.description: tell + kishi + to — buyruq yoki ko'rsatmani yetkazish; ask + kishi + to — iltimosni yetkazish. Bu — buyruq gapning o'zlashtirma shakli (50-dars): «Wait!» → He told me **to wait**.

sentences.text: The doctor **told me to stay** in bed for three days.
sentences.translation: Shifokor menga uch kun to'shakda **yotishimni aytdi**.

sentences.text: I **asked Aziz to lend** me his bike.
sentences.translation: Azizdan velosipedini **berib turishini so'radim**.

sentences.text: Who **told** you **to come** here?
sentences.translation: Bu yerga **kelishingizni** kim **aytdi**?

sentences.text: Emma **asked the waiter to bring** the bill.
sentences.translation: Emma ofitsiantdan hisobni **olib kelishini so'radi**.

sentences.text: **Ask** your brother **to turn** the music down, please.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, akangdan musiqani **pasaytirishini so'ra**.

sentences.text: My mother always **tells me to eat** more vegetables.
sentences.translation: Onam menga doim ko'proq sabzavot **yeyishimni aytadi**.

sentences.text: The police officer **told the driver to show** his licence.
sentences.translation: Politsiyachi haydovchiga guvohnomasini **ko'rsatishni buyurdi**.

sentences.text: Did you **ask** Sarah **to book** the tickets? — Yes, she's doing it now.
sentences.translation: Saradan chiptalarni **bron qilishini so'radingizmi**? — Ha, hozir qilyapti.

sentences.text: At the airport they **asked everyone to take** off their shoes.
sentences.translation: Aeroportda hammadan poyabzalini **yechishni so'rashdi**.

sentences.text: Last week the manager **told us to finish** the report before Friday, but we didn't.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta menejer hisobotni jumagacha **tugatishimizni aytdi**, lekin biz tugatmadik.

examples.title: **advise**, **remind**, **invite**, **teach** somebody **to**
examples.description: Shu qolipdagi boshqa fe'llar: advise (maslahat bermoq), remind (eslatmoq), invite (taklif qilmoq), teach (o'rgatmoq), expect (kutmoq), help (yordam bermoq; help dan keyin to ixtiyoriy).

sentences.text: A friend of mine **advised me to try** this restaurant.
sentences.translation: Bir do'stim menga bu restoranni **sinab ko'rishni maslahat berdi**.

sentences.text: Please **remind me to buy** a birthday card for Emma.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, Emma uchun tabriknoma **sotib olishimni eslatib qo'ying**.

sentences.text: Lola **invited us to stay** at her house in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Lola bizni Buxorodagi uyida **qolishga taklif qildi**.

sentences.text: My grandfather **taught me to play** chess when I was seven.
sentences.translation: Bobom yetti yoshimda menga shaxmat **o'ynashni o'rgatgan**.

sentences.text: Nobody **expected Tom to win** the race.
sentences.translation: Hech kim Tomning poygada **g'olib chiqishini kutmagan edi**.

sentences.text: Could you **help me to move** this table? — Sure.
sentences.translation: Bu stolni **surishga yordam berib yuborasizmi**? — Albatta.

sentences.text: Our teacher **encourages us to ask** questions in class.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz bizni darsda savol **berishga undaydi**.

sentences.text: James **reminded everyone to switch off** their phones before the concert.
sentences.translation: Konsert oldidan Jeyms hammaga telefonlarini **o'chirishni eslatdi**.

sentences.text: Who **taught** you **to cook** such delicious plov?
sentences.translation: Sizga bunday mazali palov **pishirishni** kim **o'rgatdi**?

sentences.text: Last month the company **invited Bekzod to give** a talk at their conference in Manchester.
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy kompaniya Bekzodni Manchesterdagi konferensiyasida **ma'ruza qilishga taklif qildi**.

examples.title: Negative: **told me not to**, **don't want you to**
examples.description: Inkor ikki xil: (1) to oldidan not — told me **not to** go; (2) birinchi fe'l inkorda — **don't want** you **to** go. «I want you don't go» — xato.

sentences.text: The doctor **told me not to lift** anything heavy.
sentences.translation: Shifokor menga og'ir narsa **ko'tarmasligimni aytdi**.

sentences.text: I **don't want you to worry** about me.
sentences.translation: Men haqimda **xavotirlanishingizni istamayman**.

sentences.text: Mum **asked us not to make** any noise after ten.
sentences.translation: Oyim soat o'ndan keyin **shovqin qilmasligimizni so'radi**.

sentences.text: We **advise** passengers **not to leave** their bags on the seats.
sentences.translation: Yo'lovchilarga sumkalarini o'rindiqlarda **qoldirmaslikni maslahat beramiz**.

sentences.text: My parents **didn't want me to move** to London.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam Londonga **ko'chishimni xohlamadi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **warned** his son **not to touch** the hot stove.
sentences.translation: Bekzod o'g'liga issiq plitaga **tegmaslikni tayinladi**.

sentences.text: Why **don't** you **want** Madina **to know** about the party?
sentences.translation: Nega Madinaning ziyofat haqida **bilishini istamaysiz**?

sentences.text: Sarah **asked me not to tell** anyone her secret.
sentences.translation: Sara sirini hech kimga **aytmasligimni so'radi**.

sentences.text: The teacher **doesn't want anybody to use** a phone during the test.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi test paytida hech kimning telefondan **foydalanishini istamaydi**.

sentences.text: I **told** you **to turn** left, **not** right! — Sorry, I didn't hear you.
sentences.translation: Senga chapga **burilishni aytgandim**, o'ngga **emas**! — Kechir, eshitmay qoldim.

examples.title: **make** somebody **do**
examples.description: make + kishi + fe'l (to SIZ!) — majbur qilmoq yoki biror holatga solmoq: made me laugh — «kuldirdi», made us wait — «kuttirdi». O'zbekchadagi orttirma nisbatga (`-tir`, `-dir`, `-t`) o'xshaydi.

sentences.text: That film **made me cry**.
sentences.translation: U film meni **yig'latdi**.

sentences.text: Our teacher **made us rewrite** the whole essay.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchimiz bizga butun inshoni **qayta yozdirdi**.

sentences.text: Aziz always **makes everyone laugh** at parties.
sentences.translation: Aziz ziyofatlarda doim hammani **kuldiradi**.

sentences.text: The long queue at the bank **made us wait** for an hour.
sentences.translation: Bankdagi uzun navbat bizni bir soat **kuttirdi**.

sentences.text: My mother **made me clean** my room before I went out.
sentences.translation: Onam ko'chaga chiqishimdan oldin meni xonamni **yig'ishtirishga majbur qildi**.

sentences.text: What **made** you **change** your mind?
sentences.translation: Sizni **fikringizni o'zgartirishga** nima **majbur qildi**?

sentences.text: Don't **make** me **say** it again!
sentences.translation: Meni buni yana **aytishga majbur qilmang**!

sentences.text: The cold weather **made** the children **stay** indoors all weekend.
sentences.translation: Sovuq havo tufayli bolalar butun dam olish kunlari uyda **qolishga majbur bo'lishdi**.

sentences.text: In the army they **make** you **get up** at five every morning.
sentences.translation: Armiyada har kuni ertalab soat beshda **turishga majbur qilishadi**.

sentences.text: James didn't want to go, but his wife **made him come** with us.
sentences.translation: Jeyms borishni xohlamadi, lekin xotini uni biz bilan **kelishga majbur qildi**.

examples.title: **let** somebody **do**
examples.description: let + kishi + fe'l (to siz) — ruxsat bermoq, qo'ymoq: didn't let us play — «o'ynagani qo'ymadi». **Let me** + fe'l — yordam yoki taklif («... qilib beray»).

sentences.text: **Let me help** you with that heavy box.
sentences.translation: Keling, o'sha og'ir qutini ko'tarishga **yordamlashay**.

sentences.text: My parents **let me stay** up late on Saturdays.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam shanba kunlari kech **yotishimga ruxsat berishadi**.

sentences.text: The guard **didn't let us take** photos inside the museum.
sentences.translation: Qorovul muzey ichida **suratga olishimizga ruxsat bermadi**.

sentences.text: Will your boss **let you leave** early on Friday?
sentences.translation: Boshlig'ingiz juma kuni ertaroq **ketishingizga ruxsat beradimi**?

sentences.text: Please **let me know** when you arrive in London.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, Londonga yetib borganingizda **xabar bering**.

sentences.text: Madina never **lets anyone drive** her new car.
sentences.translation: Madina yangi mashinasini hech kimga **haydashga bermaydi**.

sentences.text: **Let** the children **play** — they're on holiday!
sentences.translation: Bolalarni **qo'ying, o'ynashsin** — ular ta'tilda!

sentences.text: Our landlord **doesn't let tenants keep** pets in the flat.
sentences.translation: Uy egamiz ijarachilarga kvartirada uy hayvoni **saqlashga ruxsat bermaydi**.

sentences.text: **Let** me **think** about it, and I'll tell you tomorrow.
sentences.translation: **O'ylab ko'ray**, ertaga aytaman.

sentences.text: At first the guard **made** us **wait** outside, but then he **let** us **go** in.
sentences.translation: Avvaliga qo'riqchi bizni tashqarida **kuttirdi**, keyin esa ichkariga **kiritdi**.

examples.title: Mixed: **want to** or **want you to**? **make** or **let**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: o'zi qilishi (want to go) va boshqa birov qilishi (want **you to** go), majburlash (make) va ruxsat (let).

sentences.text: I **want to go** home, but my friends **want me to stay**.
sentences.translation: Men uyga **ketmoqchiman**, lekin do'stlarim **qolishimni xohlashadi**.

sentences.text: **Does** your teacher **let** you **use** a dictionary in exams?
sentences.translation: O'qituvchingiz imtihonda lug'atdan **foydalanishga ruxsat beradimi**?

sentences.text: Dad **didn't let** me **drive**, so he **made** my brother **take** me to the station.
sentences.translation: Dadam mashina **haydashimga ruxsat bermadi**, shuning uchun akamni meni vokzalga **olib borishga majbur qildi**.

sentences.text: We **don't want to be** late, so we**'d like you to come** at eight.
sentences.translation: **Kechikishni xohlamaymiz**, shuning uchun soat sakkizda **kelishingizni istardik**.

sentences.text: Why **did** the police **make** everyone **leave** the building? — There was a fire alarm.
sentences.translation: Nega politsiya hammani binodan **chiqib ketishga majbur qildi**? — Yong'in signali chalindi.

sentences.text: Emma **would like to travel** alone, but her parents **want her to go** with a friend.
sentences.translation: Emma yolg'iz **sayohat qilmoqchi**, lekin ota-onasi uning dugonasi bilan **borishini xohlashadi**.

sentences.text: The manager **let us finish** early on Friday — it was his birthday.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni menejer bizga ishni ertaroq **tugatishga ruxsat berdi** — uning tug'ilgan kuni edi.

sentences.text: My grandmother **taught me to make** bread, and now my children **want me to teach** them.
sentences.translation: Buvim menga non **yopishni o'rgatgan**, endi bolalarim ularga ham **o'rgatishimni xohlashadi**.

sentences.text: Please **don't make me eat** this soup — I really don't like fish.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, bu sho'rvani **yeyishga majbur qilmang** — baliqni umuman yoqtirmayman.

sentences.text: At the hospital they **didn't let me see** my friend, but they **asked me to come** back tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Shifoxonada do'stimni **ko'rgani qo'yishmadi**, lekin ertaga **qayta kelishimni so'rashdi**.
